Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Ed Gardner is credited on 139 distinct recordings across 6 programs from 1939-08-31 through 1951-12-28. Documented roles include performer on 135 recordings, director on 35 recordings, producer on 12 recordings, and radio adaptor on 4 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Duffy's Tavern (performer on 126 recordings, director on 35 recordings, and producer on 12 recordings; 126 distinct recordings), Columbia Workshop (performer on 6 recordings; 6 distinct recordings), The Railroad Hour (radio adaptor on 4 recordings; 4 distinct recordings), Sealtest Variety Theater (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), The Big Show (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording), and The Fred Allen Show (performer on 1 recording; 1 distinct recording).

Documented character portrayals include Archie (126 portrayals).
